result_text:
The four payment lists (all payments, one customer, one region, one sales rep's customers) now leave out payments on cancelled invoices. I haven't added a test for the Alpha example. The existing suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`).

In `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStorePart04.java` I added `AND i.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the customer statement uses, to these queries:
- `findPaymentsByPeriod`
- `findPaymentsByPeriodAndCustomer`
- `findPaymentsByRegionAndPeriod`
- `findPaymentsBySalesRepAndPeriod`

I also added it to `findPaymentTotalsPerMonthByRegion`. The region result carries those monthly totals next to its list, so without it they would still include the cancelled payments.

I did not change `findPaymentTotalsPerDay` or `findPaymentsPerSalesRep`. They are period totals rather than payment lists, and they still count payments on cancelled invoices. Say if you want those filtered too.
